note: Hand written. Every date and format here was checked against data/matches.json, so a landmark only shows if the match is really in the data on that day.

landmarks.title: The first Test
landmarks.note: India's first day as a Test nation, at Lord's, three days after being granted status. Lost, but Mohammad Nissar took five in the first innings.

landmarks.title: The first win
landmarks.note: Twenty years and 24 Tests before India won one. Vinoo Mankad took eight in the match at Chennai.

landmarks.title: First win in the Caribbean
landmarks.note: Port of Spain, and a 21 year old Sunil Gavaskar's first series. India had never beaten West Indies anywhere.

landmarks.title: The Oval, 1971
landmarks.note: India's first series win in England, sealed by Chandrasekhar's six for 38.

landmarks.title: 406 to win
landmarks.note: The fourth innings chase at Port of Spain that nobody had made before. Viswanath 112, Gavaskar 102.

landmarks.title: The World Cup
landmarks.note: Bowled out for 183 at Lord's and still beat West Indies. The match that turned India into a cricket economy.

landmarks.title: Champions of the world
landmarks.note: Melbourne, the World Championship of Cricket, and India beating Pakistan in the final.

landmarks.title: Lord's, again
landmarks.note: Kapil Dev's side won at Lord's and took the series. India would not win in England again for 21 years.

landmarks.title: Eden Gardens
landmarks.note: Following on 274 behind, Laxman made 281 and Dravid 180. Australia's sixteen match winning streak ended here.

landmarks.title: The shirt at Lord's
landmarks.note: Chasing 326 in the NatWest final, Kaif and Yuvraj got them home with three balls left.

landmarks.title: The final India lost
landmarks.note: Johannesburg. Ponting made 140 not out and Australia's 359 was never in doubt.

landmarks.title: Multan
landmarks.note: India's first Test win in Pakistan, built on Sehwag's 309, the first triple hundred by an Indian.

landmarks.title: The first World T20
landmarks.note: Johannesburg, five runs, Misbah's scoop to Sreesanth, and a format nobody took seriously until that night.

landmarks.title: The Border Gavaskar, and a farewell
landmarks.note: Nagpur, the series sealed, and the last Test for both Kumble's era and Ganguly.

landmarks.title: Wankhede
landmarks.note: Dhoni promoted himself and finished it with six over long on. India's first World Cup win at home.

landmarks.title: Champions Trophy
landmarks.note: Birmingham, a twenty over shootout in the rain, and five runs in it at the end.

landmarks.title: The semi final
landmarks.note: Manchester, 5 for 3 chasing 240, and Jadeja's 77 not quite enough. The reserve day defeat.

landmarks.title: The Gabba
landmarks.note: A side missing most of its first choice bowlers chased 328 at a ground Australia had not lost at since 1988.

landmarks.title: Ahmedabad
landmarks.note: Ten wins, then the eleventh. 130,000 people went very quiet.

landmarks.title: Bridgetown
landmarks.note: Seven runs defended in the last over, and a first world title in thirteen years.
